# Comfy Kling 4.0- Video Edit

Edit an existing clip in one pass with Kling 4.0: name the change and list what must survive, and the model rewrites only that part while keeping the subject, costume, shot count, camera work and timing intact. Output inherits the input's length and aspect ratio, and stereo audio is regenerated to match the new scene. Ideal for swapping environments, wardrobe or style on footage that is already cut. Runs on Comfy Cloud and needs Comfy Cloud partner credits.

**How it works:** The Comfy nodes form the complete template graph. Run submits the graph to Comfy Cloud and saves its outputs.

**Try this:** Change the prompt or the Load node inputs and run again to compare results.

Source: https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/blob/1ae390968e323dba24a6991d1860ded051f5a79b/templates/api_kling4_video_edit.json (MIT). Model licenses apply separately.
